title: Chapter 16 – Daivāsura Sampad Vibhāga Yoga (The Yoga of Divine and Demonic Qualities)
subtitle: Yoga of Divine and Demonic Qualities

verses.title: 16.1 abhayam sattva-sanshuddhir
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः ।
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् ॥ १६-१॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
abhayaṃ sattvasaṃśuddhihi jñānayogavyavasthitiḥ
dānaṃ damaśca yajñaśca svādhyāyastapa ārjavam 16-1
verses.colloquial:
shriibhagavaanuvaacha
abhayam sattva samshuddhih jnaana yoga vyavasthitih
daanam damah cha yajnah cha svaadhyaayah tapa aarjavam 16-1
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: Freedom from fear, a pure heart, firm commitment to the Yoga of Knowledge, giving to others, mastery over the senses, sacrifice, study of the Shastras, and honesty . . .

verses.title: 16.2 ahimsa satyam akrodhas
verses.sanskrit:
अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम् ।
दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम् ॥ १६-२॥
verses.roman:
ahiṃsā satyamakrodhastyāgaḥ śāntirapaiśunam
dayā bhūteṣvaloluptvaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam 16-2
verses.colloquial:
ahimsaa satyam akrodhas tyaagah shaantir apaishunam
dayaa bhuuteshu aloluptvam maardavam hriir achaapalam 16-2
verses.translation_reworded: Doing no harm, truthfulness, freedom from anger, renunciation, calmness, freedom from deceit, compassion toward living beings, freedom from greed, gentleness, modesty, freedom from restlessness . . .

verses.title: 16.3 tejah kshama dhritih
verses.sanskrit:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता ।
भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत ॥ १६-३॥
verses.roman:
tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ śaucamadroho nātimānitā
bhavanti sampadaṃ daivīmabhijātasya bhārata 16-3
verses.colloquial:
tejah kshamaa dhritih shaucham adroho naatimaanitaa
bhavanti sampadam daiviim abhijaatasya bhaarata 16-3
verses.translation_reworded: Energy, forgiveness, endurance, purity, freedom from hatred, freedom from pride: these, O Bharata, are the marks of one born to the divine condition.

verses.title: 16.4 dambho darpo bhimanash
verses.sanskrit:
दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च ।
अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम् ॥ १६-४॥
verses.roman:
dambho darpo'bhimānaśca krodhaḥ pāruṣyameva ca
ajñānaṃ cābhijātasya pārtha sampadamāsurīm 16-4
verses.colloquial:
dambho darpah abhimaanash cha krodhah paarushyam eva cha
ajnaanam cha abhijaatasya paartha sampadam aasuriim 16-4
verses.translation_reworded: Hypocrisy, arrogance, self-conceit, anger, and also harshness and ignorance: these, O Partha, mark one born to the demonic condition.

verses.title: 16.5 daivi sampad vimokshaya
verses.sanskrit:
दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता ।
मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव ॥ १६-५॥
verses.roman:
daivī sampadvimokṣāya nibandhāyāsurī matā
mā śucaḥ sampadaṃ daivīmabhijāto'si pāṇḍava 16-5
verses.colloquial:
daivii sampad vimokshaaya nibandhaaya aasurii mataa
maa shuchah sampadam daiviim abhijaatah asi paandava 16-5
verses.translation_reworded: The divine nature is considered to lead to liberation, the demonic to bondage. Do not grieve, O Pandava; you were born with divine qualities.

verses.title: 16.6 dvau bhuta-sargau
verses.sanskrit:
द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च ।
दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श‍ृणु ॥ १६-६॥
verses.roman:
dvau bhūtasargau loke'smindaiva āsura eva ca
daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu 16-6
verses.colloquial:
dvau bhuuta sargau loke'smin daiva aasura eva cha
daivo vistarashah prokta aasuram paartha me shrinu 16-6
verses.translation_reworded: In this world there are two kinds of beings, the divine and the demonic. The divine kind has already been described in detail; now hear from Me, O Partha, about the demonic.

verses.title: 16.7 pravrittim cha nivrittim
verses.sanskrit:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः ।
न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते ॥ १६-७॥
verses.roman:
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥ
na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate 16-7
verses.colloquial:
pravrittim cha nivrittim cha janaa na vidur aasuraah
na shaucham naapi cha aachaaro na satyam teshu vidyate 16-7
verses.translation_reworded: Demonic people do not understand what should be done and what should be avoided. No purity, no right conduct, and no truth can be found in them.

verses.title: 16.8 asatyam apratishtham
verses.sanskrit:
असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम् ।
अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम् ॥ १६-८॥
verses.roman:
asatyamapratiṣṭhaṃ te jagadāhuranīśvaram
aparasparasambhūtaṃ kimanyatkāmahaitukam 16-8
verses.colloquial:
asatyam apratishtham te jagad aahur aniishvaram
aparaspara sambhuutam kim anyat kaama haitukam 16-8
verses.translation_reworded: They declare that the universe has no truth in it, no moral foundation, and no God; that it is not produced by any orderly chain of causes, but arises from lust alone. What else could there be?

verses.title: 16.9 etam drishtim avashtabhya
verses.sanskrit:
एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः ।
प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः ॥ १६-९॥
verses.roman:
etāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhyan aṣṭātmāno'lpabuddhayaḥ
prabhavant yugrakarmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato'hitāḥ 16-9
verses.colloquial:
etaam drishtim avashtabhya nashtaatmaano'lpabuddhayah
prabhavanti ugra karmaanah kshayaaya jagato'hitaah 16-9
verses.translation_reworded: Clinging to this view, these lost souls, feeble in understanding and violent in action, rise up as enemies of the world, bent on its destruction.

verses.title: 16.10 kamam ashritya dushpuram
verses.sanskrit:
काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः ।
मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः ॥ १६-१०॥
verses.roman:
kāmamāśritya duṣpūraṃ dambhamānamadānvitāḥ
mohādgṛhītvāsadgrāhān pravartante'śucivratāḥ 16-10
verses.colloquial:
kaamam aashritya dushpuuram dambha maana madaanvitaah
mohaat grihiitvaa asadgraahaan pravartante ashuchi vrataah 16-10
verses.translation_reworded: Full of desires that can never be satisfied, steeped in hypocrisy, pride, and arrogance, holding wicked notions out of delusion, they act with impure intentions.

verses.title: 16.11 chintam aparimeyam
verses.sanskrit:
चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः ।
कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः ॥ १६-११॥
verses.roman:
cintāmaparimeyāṃ ca pralayāntāmupāśritāḥ
kāmopabhogaparamā etāvaditi niścitāḥ 16-11
verses.colloquial:
chintaam aparimeyaam cha pralayaantaam upaashritaah
kaamopabhoga paramaa etaavad iti nishchitaah 16-11
verses.translation_reworded: They surrender to countless anxieties that end only at death. They treat the satisfaction of lust as the highest goal and are convinced that this is all there is.

verses.title: 16.12 asha-pasha-shatair
verses.sanskrit:
आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः ।
ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान् ॥ १६-१२॥
verses.roman:
āśāpāśaśatairbaddhāḥ kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ
īhante kāmabhogārtham anyāyenārthasañcayān 16-12
verses.colloquial:
aashaa paasha shatair baddhaah kaama krodha paraayanaah
iihante kaama bhoga artham anyaayena artha sanchayaan 16-12
verses.translation_reworded: Tied down by a hundred cords of hope, given over to lust and anger, they struggle to pile up wealth by unlawful means in order to satisfy their senses.

verses.title: 16.13 idam adya maya labdham
verses.sanskrit:
इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम् ।
इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम् ॥ १६-१३॥
verses.roman:
idamadya mayā labdhamimaṃ prāpsye manoratham
idamastīdamapi me bhaviṣyati punardhanam 16-13
verses.colloquial:
idam adya mayaa labdham imam praapsye manoratham
idam asti idam api me bhavishyati punah dhanam 16-13
verses.translation_reworded: "Today I have gained this. This wish I will fulfill. This is mine, and that wealth too will be mine in the future."

verses.title: 16.14 asau maya hatah shatrur
verses.sanskrit:
असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि ।
ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी ॥ १६-१४॥
verses.roman:
asau mayā hataḥ śatrurhaniṣye cāparānapi
īśvaro'hamahaṃ bhogī siddho'haṃ balavānsukhī 16-14
verses.colloquial:
asau mayaa hatah shatrur hanishye cha aparaan api
iishvarah aham aham bhogii siddhah aham balavaan sukhii 16-14
verses.translation_reworded: "I have killed that enemy, and I will destroy the others as well. I am the master. I am the one who enjoys. I am successful, powerful, and happy."

verses.title: 16.15 adhyo bhijanavan
verses.sanskrit:
आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया ।
यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः ॥ १६-१५॥
verses.roman:
āḍhyo'bhijanavānasmi ko'nyo'sti sadṛśo mayā
yakṣye dāsyāmi modiṣya ityajñānavimohitāḥ 16-15
verses.colloquial:
aadhyo'bhijanavaan asmi ko'nyo'sti sadrisho mayaa
yakshye daasyaami modishya ity ajnaana vimohitaah 16-15
verses.translation_reworded: "I am wealthy and of noble birth. Who else can compare with me? I will give gifts; I will enjoy myself." In this way they are led astray by ignorance.

verses.title: 16.16 aneka-chitta-vibhranta
verses.sanskrit:
अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः ।
प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ ॥ १६-१६॥
verses.roman:
anekacittavibhrāntā mohajālasamāvṛtāḥ
prasaktāḥ kāmabhogeṣu patanti narake'śucau 16-16
verses.colloquial:
aneka chitta vibhraantaa moha jaala samaavritaah
prasaktaah kaama bhogeshu patanti narake ashuchau 16-16
verses.translation_reworded: Confused by endless fantasies, caught in the net of delusion, hooked on the satisfaction of lust, they sink into a foul hell.

verses.title: 16.17 atma-sambhavitah
verses.sanskrit:
आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः ।
यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम् ॥ १६-१७॥
verses.roman:
ātmasambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhanamānamadānvitāḥ
yajante nāmayajñaiste dambhenāvidhipūrvakam 16-17
verses.colloquial:
aatma sambhaavitaah stabdhaa dhana maana madaanvitaah
yajante naama yajnaih te dambhena avidhi puurvakam 16-17
verses.translation_reworded: Conceited, obstinate, swollen with pride and intoxicated by wealth, they perform sacrifices that are such in name only, for show, and in defiance of what scripture prescribes.

verses.title: 16.18 ahankaram balam darpam
verses.sanskrit:
अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः ।
मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः ॥ १६-१८॥
verses.roman:
ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ
māmātmaparadeheṣu pradviṣanto'bhyasūyakāḥ 16-18
verses.colloquial:
ahankaaram balam darpam kaamam krodham cha samshritaah
maam aatma para deheshu pradvishantah abhyasuuyakaah 16-18
verses.translation_reworded: Clinging to egoism, power, arrogance, lust, and anger, these spiteful people hate Me, who dwell in their own bodies and in the bodies of others.

verses.title: 16.19 tan aham dvishatah
verses.sanskrit:
तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान् ।
क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु ॥ १६-१९॥
verses.roman:
tānahaṃ dviṣataḥ krūrānsaṃsāreṣu narādhamān
kṣipāmyajasramaśubhān  āsurīṣveva yoniṣu 16-19
verses.colloquial:
taanaham dvishatah kruuraan samsaareshu naraadhamaan
kshipaami ajasram ashubhaan  aasuriishveva yonishu 16-19
verses.translation_reworded: These cruel and hateful people, the lowest of humanity in this world, these wrongdoers, I cast again and again into demonic wombs alone.

verses.title: 16.20 asurim yonim apanna
verses.sanskrit:
आसुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि ।
मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम् ॥ १६-२०॥
verses.roman:
āsurīṃ yonimāpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani
māmaprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatim 16-20
verses.colloquial:
aasuriim yonim aapannaa muudhaa janmani janmani
maam apraapyaiva kaunteya tato yaanti adhamaam gatim 16-20
verses.translation_reworded: Entering demonic wombs birth after birth, deluded and never reaching Me, they fall, O Kaunteya, into a state even lower than that.

verses.title: 16.21 tri-vidham narakasyedam
verses.sanskrit:
त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः ।
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत् ॥ १६-२१॥
verses.roman:
trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ dvāraṃ nāśanamātmanaḥ
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhastasmādetattrayaṃ tyajet 16-21
verses.colloquial:
trividham narakasya idam dvaaram naashanam aatmanah
kaamah krodhah tathaa lobhah tasmaat etat trayam tyajet 16-21
verses.translation_reworded: Lust, anger, and greed are the three gates of hell that destroy the Self. For this reason one should give up all three.

verses.title: 16.22 etair vimuktah kaunteya
verses.sanskrit:
एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः ।
आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥ १६-२२॥
verses.roman:
etairvimuktaḥ kaunteya tamodvāraistribhirnaraḥ
ācaratyātmanaḥ śreyastato yāti parāṃ gatim 16-22
verses.colloquial:
etair vimuktah kaunteya tamodvaaraih tribhir narah
aacharati aatmanah shreyas tato yaati paraam gatim 16-22
verses.translation_reworded: A person who has escaped these three gates to darkness, O Kaunteya, does what is truly good for himself, and so reaches the Supreme Goal.

verses.title: 16.23 yah shastra-vidhim
verses.sanskrit:
यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः ।
न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम् ॥ १६-२३॥
verses.roman:
yaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ
na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim 16-23
verses.colloquial:
yah shaastra vidhim utsrijya vartate kaama kaaratah
na sa siddhim avaapnoti na sukham na paraam gatim 16-23
verses.translation_reworded: One who throws aside the rules of the scriptures and acts driven by desire reaches neither perfection, nor happiness, nor the Supreme Goal.

verses.title: 16.24 tasmach chhastram
verses.sanskrit:
तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ ।
ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि ॥ १६-२४॥ 

ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
दैवासुरसम्पद्विभागयोगो नाम षोडशोऽध्यायः ॥ १६॥
verses.roman:
tasmācchāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ te kāryākāryavyavasthitau
jñātvā śāstravidhānoktaṃ karma kartumihārhasi 16-24

oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu
brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde
daivāsurasampadvibhāgayogo nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ 16
verses.colloquial:
tasmaacchaastram pramaanam te kaarya akaarya vyavasthitau
jnaatvaa shaastra vidhaana uktam karma kartum iha arhasi

om tat sat iti shriimad bhagavad giitaasu upanishatsu
brahma vidyaayaam yoga shaastre shrii krishna arjuna samvaade
daiva aasura sampad vibhaaga yogo naama shodasho'dhyaayah 16
verses.translation_reworded:
Therefore let the scriptures be your authority in deciding what should and should not be done. Once you know what the scriptural commands say, you should act accordingly here in this world.

Thus, in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna, ends the sixteenth discourse, entitled "The Yoga of Divine and Demonic Qualities."
